description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Seahawks reportedly believe QB Sam Darnold "dodged a bullet" from his hip injury in Wednesday's season opener.
items.impact: Darnold underwent an MRI on his hip Thursday morning that team doctors still are reviewing to determine how much time he will miss. It sounds like he'll likely miss at least one or two games, but it appears he won't miss an extended period of time.
items.title: Sam Darnold (hip) believed to have 'dodged a bullet'

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jakobi Meyers was in a non-contact jersey during practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Meyers remains up in the air for Sunday's season opener. His status will need to be monitored in practice on Friday.
items.title: Jakobi Meyers (thumb) in non-contact jersey in practice

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: The Seahawks' D/ST logged three sacks and three interceptions while allowing just ten points in Wednesday night's win over the New England Patriots.
items.impact: Seattle's defense put up a fantastic showing on Wednesday night. They not only held New England's strong offense to just ten points on the night, but they also recorded three interceptions, including one on the final drive of the game to seal the win. This unit is expected to be elite over the course of the season, assuming all of their key players remain healthy and on the field.
items.title: Seahawks D/ST stellar in win Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Jason Myers went 2-for-2 on his field-goal attempts and made his lone extra-point attempt in Wednesday's 13-10 win over the New England Patriots.
items.impact: Myers did his job on Wednesday, knocking in all three of his kicks en route to a win over the Patriots. He will likely be a decent fantasy option at the position over the course of the season, assuming QB Sam Darnold (hip) doesn't miss significant time and leave the offense weaker moving forward.
items.title: Jason Myers scores seven points in win Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Emanuel Wilson rushed the ball two times for three yards in Wednesday's 13-10 win over the New England Patriots.
items.impact: There were many questions about Seattle's backfield split over the course of the offseason, and we finally got some answers on Wednesday. One of the takeaways is that Wilson is not likely to be a significant contributor in the rotation, as he saw just two out of the team's 20 RB rushing attempts on the night. It looks like Jadarian Price and George Holani have squarely established themselves as the top two backs on this team, with Wilson being a distant third.
items.title: Emanuel Wilson uninvolved in win Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Cooper Kupp caught 2-of-3 targets for 35 yards in Wednesday night's 13-10 win over the New England Patriots.
items.impact: Kupp didn't end up with a strong statline in the box score on Wednesday, but he was an important player for the Seahawks in this matchup. He made multiple key plays for them and had a touchdown that got called back due to penalty. He isn't likely to be fantasy relevant moving forward, however, especially if QB Sam Darnold (hip) misses time.
items.title: Cooper Kupp totals 35 yards in win Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Sean Tucker was on the field for practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Tucker missed practice on Wednesday. He'll likely be at least a limited participant on Thursday.
items.title: Sean Tucker (hamstring) at practice Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: George Holani rushed the ball eight times for 29 yards and failed to haul in his lone target in Wednesday night's 13-10 win over the New England Patriots.
items.impact: Holani saw solid involvement on Wednesday, receiving nine total opportunities over the course of the game. He didn't do much with them, but the fact that he had a pretty even split with rookie RB Jadarian Price is a bit concerning for Price's fantasy value moving forward. It's too soon to make any definitive judgements about this offense, however, as they were without their starting quarterback for almost the entire game on Wednesday.
items.title: George Holani sees nine opportunities in win Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: AJ Barner caught two passes for 13 yards in Wednesday's 13-10 win over the New England Patriots.
items.impact: The Seahawks were able to pick up a win over the Patriots on Wednesday, but they didn't need to get Barner very involved in order to do so. He finished the game with just two catches for 13 yards, and there's not much reason to believe that he will bounce back and become a quality week-to-week option anytime soon.
items.title: AJ Barner catches two passes Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Rashid Shaheed caught 1-of-3 targets for just four yards in Wednesday's 13-10 win over the New England Patriots.
items.impact: The speedy wideout wasn't able to do much on Wednesday, catching just one pass for four yards in the team's win over New England. The injury to starter Sam Darnold (hip) may have played a large role in his lack of production, however, so this isn't a good game to look at in order to discern his true involvement in this offense.
items.title: Rashid Shaheed quiet in win Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Jadarian Price rushed the ball ten times for 52 yards and caught two passes for six yards in Wednesday night's 13-10 win over the New England Patriots.
items.impact: The rookie had a decent performance in his NFL debut. He rushed for 52 yards at an efficient clip of 5.2 yards per carry, and he saw a bit of involvement in the passing game as well. From a fantasy perspective this was a disappointing game, but he showed promise in this game and will likely perform better in positive matchups moving forward.
items.title: Jadarian Price totals 58 yards in NFL debut Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Jaxon Smith-Njigba caught 8-of-11 targets for 122 yards and a touchdown in Wednesday night's 13-10 win over the New England Patriots.
items.impact: On Wednesday, Smith-Njigba picked up right where he left off last season, exploding for 122 yards and a touchdown in a big win over the Patriots. He did that with Drew Lock throwing him passes after starter Sam Darnold went down with a hip injury earlier in the game. Fantasy managers should be happy with his performance in this matchup but should keep a close eye on the health of Darnold, as the young wideout's week-to-week ceiling will certainly take a hit if their starting QB misses significant time.
items.title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba electric in win Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Drew Lock completed 16-of-22 passing attempts for 187 yards and one touchdown in Wednesday night's 13-10 win over the New England Patriots.
items.impact: Lock entered the game early on Wednesday night after starting QB Sam Darnold (hip) left the game with an injury. He played pretty well as the team's replacement, finishing with 200 total yards and a touchdown while limiting mistakes in a quality win over the Patriots. It remains to be seen whether or not he will have to serve as the team's starter for a while.
items.title: Drew Lock solid in win Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: The Patriots' D/ST logged two sacks and allowed 13 points in Wednesday night's loss to the Seattle Seahawks.
items.impact: New England's defense got a lucky break with QB Sam Darnold (hip) leaving early on in the game. He was replaced by Drew Lock, and while the Patriots held Seattle's offense to just 13 points, that wasn't enough to lead them to a win. This unit should be a decent option against the Steelers in Week 2.
items.title: Patriots D/ST allows 13 points in loss Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Andy Borregales made his lone field-goal attempt and his lone extra-point attempt in Wednesday night's 13-10 loss to the Seattle Seahawks.
items.impact: The young kicker didn't get many opportunities on Wednesday night. He converted both of his attempts, however, leaving him with at least four points on the night. He doesn't project to be a strong option at the position moving forward.
items.title: Andy Borregales scores four points Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Eli Raridon caught one pass for two yards and a touchdown in Wednesday's 13-10 loss to the Seattle Seahawks.
items.impact: The rookie was able to haul in his first career catch on Wednesday night, which he turned into a two-yard touchdown early on in the game. He wasn't very involved outside of that, however, failing to receive another target the rest of the game. He remains a player to keep tabs on moving forward, as his emergence would spell bad news for the streaming value of veteran Hunter Henry.
items.title: Eli Raridon catches touchdown in loss Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Mack Hollins caught 4-of-5 targets for 51 yards in Wednesday's 13-10 loss to the Seattle Seahawks.
items.impact: Hollins was one of the lone bright spots for New England on Wednesday night. He stepped up and led the team in receiving in the absence of A.J. Brown (ankle), and he made several important plays which helped to keep them in the game up until the very end. He isn't likely to be fantasy relevant moving forward but should continue to play an important role for the team.
items.title: Mack Hollins leads team in receiving Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: DeMario Douglas caught 5-of-7 targets for 20 yards in Wednesday's 13-10 loss to the Seattle Seahawks.
items.impact: Douglas was the most targeted receiver for New England last night, but he wasn't able to turn that into any fantasy success. He ended with just 20 yards on five catches, but he may continue to see high opportunities for the foreseeable future with A.J. Brown (ankle) set to miss some time for the team.
items.title: DeMario Douglas catches five passes Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Hunter Henry caught three passes for 26 yards in Wednesday's 13-10 loss to the Seattle Seahawks.
items.impact: New England's offense wasn't very effective on Wednesday night, and Henry was no exception to that. He totaled just 26 scoreless yards against the Seahawks, which left him with a poor fantasy total. His value as a streaming option may be diminished this year with Eli Raridon seemingly primed to be more involved at the tight end position for the Patriots.
items.title: Hunter Henry hauls in three passes Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Romeo Doubs didn't haul in any of his three targets in Wednesday night's 10-13 loss to the Seattle Seahawks.
items.impact: Doubs did not get off to a good start with his new team on Wednesday night. He failed to haul in even a single catch against a tough Seattle defense, and he had a costly drop on a very important play late in the game. He should bounce back in the near future and may be a worthwhile fantasy option short-term with A.J. Brown (ankle) expected to miss a bit of time due to injury.
items.title: Romeo Doubs fails to log catch Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Rhamondre Stevenson rushed the ball 18 times for 51 yards and caught five passes for 44 yards in Wednesday night's 13-10 loss to the Seattle Seahawks.
items.impact: Stevenson was New England's workhorse running back on Wednesday night with TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) out of the lineup. He ran at an inefficient clip of 2.8 yards per carry on the night, but his fantasy total was saved by the fact that he caught five passes. He will be more efficient than this in the future but will lose passing work to Henderson when he's back, so he will likely continue to be touchdown dependent on a week-to-week basis.
items.title: Rhamondre Stevenson totals 95 yards Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Drake Maye completed 23-of-33 passing attempts for 178 yards, one touchdown, and three interceptions while adding 47 yards on the ground in Wednesday night's 13-10 loss to the Seattle Seahawks.
items.impact: Maye started the season on the wrong foot on Wednesday night. He threw for under 200 yards and three interceptions against a tough Seattle defense, including one that cost the Patriots the game. He still showed lots of ability on the ground, however, and he's likely to return to being a good fantasy option against easier defenses. The loss of A.J. Brown (ankle) for at least a few games will severely hamper his short-term upside, however.
items.title: Drake Maye throws three interceptions in loss Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Andrew Thomas (knee) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran offensive lineman has had plenty of injury struggles throughout his career, but it looks like he will start out this season healthy, as he was able to practice in a full capacity on Wednesday. His expected presence will be great for QB Jaxson Dart and RB Cam Skattebo, both of whom will need a sturdy offensive line if they are going to reach their fantasy ceiling this year.
items.title: Andrew Thomas (knee) practices in full Wednesday

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: A.J. Brown (ankle) is believed to have suffered a high ankle sprain in last nights game against the Seahawks. He will have an MRI today to determine the extent of the injury and how much time he will miss.
items.impact: It's a tough start to Browns Patriot tenure. He went down early in the third quarter and did not return, leaving Drake Maye to lean on Hunter Henry, Demario Douglas, and Mack Hollins with fellow newcomer Romeo Doubs struggling to catch anything. Doubs should bounce back, and if Brown is out for any period of time, expect Doubs and Henry to have some more fantasy appeal, with Douglas as a PPR dart throw in deep formats.
items.title: A.J. Brown (ankle) believed to have suffered high-ankle sprain on Wednesday

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Nick Bosa (knee) is good to go against the Rams on Thursday. He's been practicing in a limited fashion, and though his return to play had been reported and expected, he carries no injury designation for this games.
items.impact: This is great news for Niners fans and those in IDP leagues with Bosa. He should be an anchor to that defense in a very important Week 1 for the Niners.
items.title: Nick Bosa (knee) good to go, will play Rams on Thursday
